Wheel & Sprocket Appleton Thursday Night Ride

Appleton, WI · Road

Wheel & Sprocket Appleton Thursday Night Ride is a road group ride in Appleton, WI. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Wheel & Sprocket Appleton (back parking lot).

Next ride Thu, May 6, 6:00 PM CDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed on the host's own page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Wheel & Sprocket's event calendar page (fetched Oct 1, 2026) lists no Thursday night ride and now shows winter in-store events plus the NICA state championship Oct 23-25; our record's host-stated season was May 7 to Aug 27, 2026.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups by rider level. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @wheelandsprocket the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wheel & Sprocket Appleton Thursday Night Ride group ride

A summer shop ride around Appleton and the surrounding towns. Splits into two groups so slower riders have a place. Meets in the back lot of the store.
